label: No own favouring has an independent stand-in for a non-present candidate
paraphrase: OPEN own-favouring bridge, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: for every bearer b with a favouring determination, every scenario s and every candidate x that is not a present input at s, b's stand-in for x is not independent of b: it is not the case that b neither contains (CONTAINED_IN_1) nor produces it. Rationale: the favouring is the bearer's own (not supplied by another determiner, DEF abd8cfa4), and an independent item makes a difference to a bearer by acting on it (then it is a present input) or by being represented in it (then a contained item stands for it). It excludes the independent-realm horn: Leslie-type requiredness of abstract value-facts that is creatively effective on the bearer's favouring without being present to it, a demiurge guided by Forms it neither contains nor makes, and candidates standing for themselves. At an actual root it would be a reading of an inclusive sole-foundation commitment, which is not registered as a statement; the encoded underivedness of a root (no actual concrete ground) does not imply it, since it concerns non-concrete co-determiners.
